source.name: OpenPowerlifting
source.license: Public domain (OpenPowerlifting data is contributed to the public domain)

method.dedupe: one result per lifter per lift: the heaviest (ties: most recent)
method.events: any meet event containing the lift (full power, push-pull, single lift)
method.place: numeric places only (no DQ, doping DQ, no-show or guest)
method.binning: sex x age group x 5 kg bodyweight bin; lift/bodyweight percentiles x the bin median bodyweight
method.fallback: bins under 60 lifters pool bodyweight neighbours (up to ±3 bins), then the 23–39 group
method.smoothing: weighted isotonic regression across bodyweight, 3-bin moving average, percentiles non-decreasing; bins sharing a bodyweight anchor merged
